command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx node
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E "cli|eval" ; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -120; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -150

cd /workspace; export PATH=$PATH; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -30; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -n -i -A40 "cloud eval" | head -150
cd /workspace; m="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $m cloud status 2>&1 | head -20; $m cloud projects servers --help 2>&1 | head -20; $m cloud eval list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace; m="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $m cloud projects servers --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -5; $m cloud projects servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -8; $m cloud projects servers create --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; m="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $m cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture --wait 2>&1 | tail -40; echo exit=$?

cd /workspace; cat > run_eval.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# Repeatable eval: needs MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY. Exit 0 = passed, 1 = failed verdict.
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture --wait
E
chmod +x run_eval.sh
